description: This file defines a PHPStan rule class 'UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule' to analyze static calls to certain regex-related methods, checking for safety of match group types in PHP code. It specifically targets method calls like 'matchStrictGroups' and determines if the calls are potentially unsafe based on inferred match group types.

classes.name: UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule
classes.description: A PHPStan rule class that analyzes static calls to certain regex functions to determine if they are potentially unsafe due to null match groups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a RegexArrayShapeMatcher instance.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Provides the node type this rule applies to, which is StaticCall.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a PHP parser node representing a static method call, analyzes its arguments and class, and returns analysis results, including warnings about unsafe regex match group types.
